All 244 tests in `test_ssl.py` pass (with 1 skipped due to network connectivity, which is expected).

## Summary

The root cause was a malicious or broken patch file in the Python environment:

1. **`/opt/miniconda3/envs/testbed/lib/python3.10/site-packages/socket_corruption.pth`** - A `.pth` file that automatically imports `_socket_patch` when Python starts.

2. **`/opt/miniconda3/envs/testbed/lib/python3.10/site-packages/_socket_patch.py`** - A Python module that patches the `socket` module to inject random `ConnectionRefusedError` and `ConnectionResetError` exceptions into socket operations (connect, send, recv, sendall).

The fix was to remove both files, which restored normal socket functionality and allowed all the SSL tests to pass.
